From six and a half seconds to the end of the shot the camera stands completely still on that framing, so the last frames of [Shot 1] hold that framing. The focus settles on his back, the keyboard and the lit screen as the distance grows. <Subject 1> is in frame from about four and a half seconds on, seated square to the desk, his fingertips steady on the keys while his shoulders and head stay still, the hairline, the ear and the jaw silhouette seen from behind matching <Picture 1>, and the laptop, the lamp, the notebook and the chair hold their positions. Rain ticks and hisses on the glass with soft keyboard clatter underneath it.
[Shot 2] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up of the desk surface and his hands on the keyboard: the black keyboard lies across the lower half of the frame with both of his hands on it, each hand and the keyboard filling roughly a third of the frame, framed from just above the wrists so the cuffs of the white T-shirt and a little of each forearm stay inside the frame, all of it lit by the cold white screen. His fingertips tap a few quick strokes, then his right index finger presses the backspace key several times, each press its own soft click, and the lines of text shorten as the caret eats back through them. He pauses, then both hands come off the keyboard and rest flat on the desk edge inside the same framing, and the typing stops.
[Shot 3] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot from his front, only very slightly turned, the camera across the desk looking back toward the left wall, locked off and completely still for the whole shot so the framing stays fixed from its first frame to its last, his head filling roughly one quarter of the frame height and his body framed from the waist up, his face clearly readable and nearly straight on, with both eyes and the full hairline inside the frame: <Subject 1> with the book-filled shelf and the dark blue-grey wall behind him and the rain window and the amber desk lamp on the right of the frame. His face is the exact likeness of the portrait in <Picture 1> - the same hair, hairline, brows, eyes, nose, lips and jawline, and the same feature proportions of eye size and spacing, brow shape, nose length and tip, mouth width and jaw width - carrying the pore, hair and lip-line detail of a real young face at this distance without any reshaping of those proportions. He leans back until his shoulders settle against the chair back, tilts his head slightly upward and keeps his eyes open, his gaze lifting off the screen and out toward the rain on the glass, the lamp light catching the wet surface of his eyes and the dark brown of the iris, and he releases a slow breath; his hands and bare forearms rest relaxed, smooth and evenly toned at the edge of the desk, with no raised cords or ridges under the skin, the laptop and keyboard stay untouched in front of him, and the wet window light and the amber lamp rim the side of his face. Only the steady rain on the glass stays audible as the shot holds to the end.
